title: Allowed blocked status is derived from untrusted child output
title_de: Erlaubter Blocked-Status wird aus nicht vertrauenswürdiger Child-Ausgabe abgeleitet
summary: The check-status wrapper parsed an approved blocked-reason marker from combined child stdout and stderr. A child that exited 77 could print the marker and make the wrapper return workflow success. The Parent now owns that disposition through a structured preflight, and the original spoof and legitimate-control cases are verified on master.
summary_de: Der Check-Status-Wrapper parste einen erlaubten Blocked-Reason-Marker aus kombinierter Child-stdout- und stderr-Ausgabe. Ein Child mit Exit 77 konnte den Marker ausgeben und den Wrapper zu Workflow-Erfolg veranlassen. Der Parent besitzt diese Disposition nun über einen strukturierten Preflight; die ursprünglichen Spoof- und legitimen Kontrollfälle sind auf Master verifiziert.
observed_behavior: `ci/tools/run-check-status.py:186-210` accepted `CHECK_STATUS_REASON` from child output and `workflow_exit_code` returned zero for an allowlisted reason. Controlled stdout and stderr fixtures both produced `allowed_by_contract=true` and workflow exit code zero.
observed_behavior_de: `ci/tools/run-check-status.py:186-210` akzeptierte `CHECK_STATUS_REASON` aus Child-Ausgabe, und `workflow_exit_code` gab für einen allowgelisteten Reason null zurück. Kontrollierte stdout- und stderr-Fixtures erzeugten beide `allowed_by_contract=true` und Workflow-Exit-Code null.
expected_behavior: Only a parent-verified prerequisite condition may produce an allowed blocked disposition. A child exit code or free-form output must remain diagnostic data and cannot authorize workflow success.
expected_behavior_de: Nur eine vom Parent verifizierte Prerequisite darf eine erlaubte Blocked-Disposition erzeugen. Ein Child-Exit-Code oder frei formatierte Ausgabe bleibt Diagnosedaten und darf keinen Workflow-Erfolg autorisieren.
impact: A compromised, faulty, or intentionally permissive child command could mask a required check failure as an allowed environment block.
impact_de: Ein kompromittiertes, fehlerhaftes oder absichtlich permissives Child-Kommando konnte einen erforderlichen Check-Fehler als erlaubten Environment-Block maskieren.
preconditions: The executed child can emit stdout or stderr and exit 77.
reproduction: Run the retained stderr spoof fixture through `run-check-status.py` with the allowlisted reason.
Run the retained stdout spoof fixture through the same wrapper.
Observe structured blocked status with `allowed_by_contract=true` and wrapper exit code zero in both cases.

evidence.command: rtk env BUILD_ROOT=<task-run> PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python ci/tools/run-check-status.py --check status_spoof --allow-blocked-reason apache_development_prerequisite -- <controlled-fixture>
rtk git rev-parse/diff; rtk make check-optional-prerequisite-status/check-ci-security-contract; rtk gh pr view/run list for PR #56 and master a73c33529f4b900e0e5722f6c8eae2ae47e41c1f

root_cause: The status channel treated free-form child diagnostics as authoritative control data and joined them with the allowlist decision.
root_cause_de: Der Statuskanal behandelte frei formatierte Child-Diagnostik als autoritative Kontrolldaten und verband sie mit der Allowlist-Entscheidung.
proposed_remediation: Move the allowed missing-prerequisite decision into an explicit parent-side structured disposition and remove child-text authorization. Preserve arbitrary child output only as escaped diagnostics and reject unclassified exit-77 results.
proposed_remediation_de: Die Entscheidung über die erlaubte fehlende Prerequisite in eine explizite strukturierte Parent-Disposition verschieben und Child-Text-Autorisierung entfernen. Beliebige Child-Ausgabe nur als escaped Diagnostik behalten und nicht klassifizierte Exit-77-Ergebnisse ablehnen.
acceptance_criteria: Neither stdout nor stderr marker text can change a child failure into an allowed blocked workflow result.
A real parent-detected missing Apache development prerequisite remains an explicit, schema-valid blocked result.
All other child failures, including exit 77, remain nonzero.
The persisted status record records the parent disposition and does not use untrusted child text as its reason field.
validation_plan: Add stdout and stderr spoof fixtures before the fix and show both fail after it.
Exercise a parent-detected missing-prerequisite control and ordinary child failure control.
Run the focused optional-prerequisite status test suite and security diff scan.
legitimate_control_tests: A genuine missing Apache development prerequisite produces a parent-authenticated allowed blocked status.
A valid child command succeeds without relying on a status marker.
residual_risk: PR #56 final head cd0211bbefd4baef4ddee300ccf872e4d1ad9a53 is merged as master a73c33529f4b900e0e5722f6c8eae2ae47e41c1f; the master tree is identical to that head, the 20-test original-spoof/bypass/legitimate-control suite passes, and all observed exact-master workflows pass. APXS selector configuration remains trusted job/operator input; current production PR workflows do not route untrusted PR input to it. Reassess if that trust boundary changes. No risk acceptance exists. This finding is verified, not closed; closure requires a distinct lifecycle decision.
residual_risk_de: Der finale PR-#56-Head cd0211bbefd4baef4ddee300ccf872e4d1ad9a53 ist als Master a73c33529f4b900e0e5722f6c8eae2ae47e41c1f gemergt; der Master-Tree ist mit diesem Head identisch, die 20-Test-Suite für ursprüngliche Spoof-/Bypass-/legitime Kontrollfälle besteht, und alle beobachteten exakten Master-Workflows bestehen. Die APXS-Selector-Konfiguration bleibt vertrauenswürdige Job-/Operator-Eingabe; aktuelle produktive PR-Workflows leiten keine nicht vertrauenswürdige PR-Eingabe dorthin. Bei Änderung dieser Vertrauensgrenze erneut bewerten. Es gibt keine Risikoakzeptanz. Dieser Befund ist verifiziert, nicht geschlossen; ein Abschluss erfordert eine separate Lifecycle-Entscheidung.

history.detail: Independent controlled stdout and stderr marker fixtures both received an allowed blocked workflow disposition.
PR 56 exact head passed local controls, 33 GitHub checks, CodeQL, SonarCloud, and focused security review. The finding remains fixed rather than verified/closed until merge and master rerun.

PR #56 merged at a73c33529f4b900e0e5722f6c8eae2ae47e41c1f. origin/master equals that SHA and its tree equals final PR head cd0211bbefd4baef4ddee300ccf872e4d1ad9a53. The original spoof, bypass, and legitimate-control suite passed 20 tests; the related 13-test workflow-permission contract also passed. All 14 observed workflows for the exact master SHA, including OpenSSF Scorecard, CodeQL, Security workflow lint, and verified-report-governance, completed successfully. The fix is verified, not closed.

The current user authorized closure and archival. On Parent master 6ca7e1536ce7e93da68099db9c586b88852ff13e, tests.test_optional_prerequisite_status passed as part of the 144-test current-master control suite, retaining the spoof, bypass, and legitimate-control coverage.
